reason: Twenty-five pounds for a jar of gummies is five times what I pay for Boots magnesium, and they are full of sugar and glucose syrup. I have never tried magnesium, so I would want to see the lab results before paying that much for something I have only heard about from friends and Instagram.
objection: Why should I pay five times the Boots price for gummies with sugar in them, when I have never tried magnesium and cannot tell if it will do anything for me?
would_change_my_mind: A much lower price, close to the Boots price, or a free or cheap single jar to try before committing to more.
